library.name: Owner
library.description: A widget that display the current ticket owner and allows quick assignment

extension_params.data_query:
type:worklist.records
of:ticket
expand:[owner_]
query:(
  id:{{record_id}}
  limit:1
  sort:[id]
)
format:dictionaries
extension_params.sheet_kata:
layout:
  style: fieldsets
  headings@bool: no
  paging@bool: no
  title_column: image
  colors:
    labels@csv: #646464
    labels_dark@csv: #cccccc

columns:
  icon/image:
    params:
      record_uri@raw: cerb:worker:{{owner_id}}
      text_size: 400%
      text_color: labels

  card/owner__label:
    params:
      image@bool: no
      underline@bool: no
      bold@bool: yes
      text_size: 200%
      text_color: labels
      label_template@raw: {{owner__label|default('(nobody)')}}
  
  text/owner_title:
    params:
      text_color: labels
      
  toolbar/actions:
    params:
      kata:
        interaction/assign:
          uri: cerb:automation:cerb.ticket.assign
          hidden@raw,bool: {{not cerb_record_writeable('ticket',id) or owner_id}}
          label@raw: Assign
          icon: tag
          keyboard: Shift+T
          inputs:
            ticket: {{id}}
        interaction/unassign:
          uri: cerb:automation:cerb.ticket.assign
          hidden@raw,bool: {{not cerb_record_writeable('ticket',id) or not owner_id}}
          label@raw: Unassign
          icon: remove
          keyboard: Shift+U
          inputs:
            ticket: {{id}}
            unassign: yes
